summary: Curaleaf filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) attaching a press release announcing a Notice of Variation to increase its offer to acquire all outstanding common shares of Aurora Cannabis. The Enhanced Offer values Aurora at US$5.00 per share, comprising 0.4013 Curaleaf Shares plus US$1.00 cash, based on Curaleaf's October 2, 2026 closing price of C$14.21. The filing is also a Rule 425 written communication. Curaleaf urges Aurora to engage, characterizing the offer as providing a view of combined potential. The notice extends and varies the prior offer, keeping the tender open and pressing Aurora's board.
